annotation.title_clean: Etiska aspekter gällande användning av sociala robotar i läkemedelsrådgivning - En kvalitativ studie av myndigheters och branschorganisationers synvinkel
annotation.title_en: Ethical aspects concerning the use of social robots in medication counseling: A qualitative study from the perspective of authorities and industry organizations
annotation.venue: Åbo Akademi University (Master's thesis, Caring Science)
annotation.summary_en: Master's thesis from Åbo Akademi reporting interviews with seven Finnish authority and industry-organisation representatives about ethical aspects of the social robot Furhat giving medication counselling in pharmacies. Reflexive thematic analysis yields five themes; benefits are judged to outweigh risks, though legislation and liability are unclear.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five themes: autonomy and integrity, supporting pharmacists' professional role, safety, legislation, and customer's best interest.
Participants see benefits of a social robot in pharmacy counselling outweighing drawbacks.
Current legislation is deficient and responsibility/liability questions are unclear.
Safety covers medication safety, machine safety and data security.
Robot cannot replace humans; balance between technological and human counselling is needed.
